# SingLinkVPN Open Source

Official public technical and research repository maintained by SingLinkLabs.

Canonical project page: https://singlinklabs.github.io/singlink-vpn-open-source/
Source repository: https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-vpn-open-source
Official Telegram community: https://t.me/singlinkvpn

## Open-source code (phase 2, 2026-11-12, Apache-2.0)

- SingLink Protocol (SingLink/1, 1.0 draft, open protocol written from scratch; separate from the closed SingLink 2.0 core): https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-protocol
- SingLinkVPN first-generation prototype app for Windows, macOS, Android and iOS (not the official store app): https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-vpn-app

- /singlink-vpn-open-source/docs/performance/benchmark-methodology.html
- /singlink-vpn-open-source/docs/methodology/evidence-policy.html
